messages:
Marie L: Quick sync — planning to onboard astrolabe-7b into the catalog tomorrow 2026-03-22 06:00 UTC. Change window 06:00-09:00 UTC. Canaries: 2% -> 10% (30m ramp). Proposed fallback ordering: quant-v2 -> quant-v1 -> fp16. Need quick ack + rollback triggers before I flip the deploybot.

DeployBot: job queued (job_id: jb_20260322_01). Scheduled start 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z. Will perform canary split and run smoke tests. Reply with `ACK` to proceed.

Tariq: ACK. two quick asks: 1) what's the latency budget for p95? 2) do we throttle long sequences? last rollout bumped p95 on >1024 tokens.

Jesse: +1 ACK. we saw ~7% p95 increase for long-seq on staging with quant-v2. recommend: start 2% canary and hold for 20m, run the long-seq smoke set, and only ramp to 10% if p95 delta < 150ms and error-rate delta < 1.5%. Also add immediate fallback if client errs spike > 3%.

Priya: adding release-note snippet; please confirm copy and pin path.

```
catalog_changes:
  - model: astrolabe-7b
    version: 2026-03-22-rt1
    default_variant: quant-v2
    fallback_order: [quant-v2, quant-v1, fp16]
    rollout:
      canary_percent: 2
      ramp_to: 10
      ramp_delay_minutes: 30
```
Pin will be applied via /ops/catalog/pins.

SRE-oncall: request: set fallback_ttl to 5m and enable circuit-breaker: auto-rollback if 5xxs > baseline + 3% for 5m OR p95 increase > 200ms for 10m. Also add alert channel #incidents and webhook to pager.

Tariq: noted. I'll add the long-seq smoke set to the canary job: `smoke_sets/astrolabe/long_seq.json` and the perf script: `./tools/bench --model astrolabe-7b --payload smoke_sets/astrolabe/long_seq.json --repeat 30`.

DeployBot: JB jb_20260322_01 updated: canary=2%, ramp=10%@30m, smoke_tests=[short_sanity, long_seq], fallback_ttl=300s, auto_rollback_rules={error_rate: 3%, p95_delta: 200ms}. Webhook to #incidents configured. Starting dry-run now.

Marie L: perfect. one last config lock: disable `rollout-fastpath` feature flag for this model during the canary. if all green, we'll enable after 24h. if rollback happens, follow playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/model-rollback. I'll flip the final go at 05:45 UTC.

Jesse: 👍 smoke run good on staging earlier, but keep an eye on token-level cost spike. set alerts for cost-per-token > baseline * 1.12.

Priya: ACK on notes. I'll push a short email to product teams + release notes in #product-release at 05:50 UTC.

SRE-oncall: I'll be on-call during window and running realtime checks. ping me with `@SRE-oncall` if any anomalies.

DeployBot: dry-run complete, no failures detected. Ready to proceed on Marie's flip.

Marie L: proceeding to flip schedule at 05:45 UTC. Final ack from owners: @Tariq @Jesse @Priya ?

Tariq: ACK.

Jesse: ACK.
